content:
Overview

Nanyuki is a city in Laikipia with a population of 50,000. A market town at the foothills of Mount Kenya, popular for safari tourism and as a gateway to the mountain. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6b growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 260 sunny days a year. The population skews young, with a median age of 20.0.
